name: Ireland
summary: The west of Ireland was full of wild rumor and legendry during the period covered by Professor Angell's press cuttings.
description:
The country appears as one cutting in Professor Angell's file, gathered for what it stood beside rather than for itself: the same line of the record carries Ardois-Bonnot's blasphemous Dream Landscape, hung that spring in Paris.

Of the rumor and legendry themselves nothing is set down — neither what was told in the west, nor by whom.

sources.quote: The west of Ireland, too, is full of wild rumor and legendry, and a fantastic painter named Ardois-Bonnot hangs a blasphemous Dream Landscape in the Paris spring salon of 1926.
